title: On the abelianization of congruence subgroups of $\mathrm{SL}_2$ over $S$-integers
summary: In this work, we compute the first integral homology, or abelianization, of the congruence subgroups $Γ(A, \mathfrak{m}_A), Γ_1(A, \mathfrak{m}_A)$, and $Γ_0(A, \mathfrak{m}_A)$ for a local ring $A$ with maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m}_A$, showing that $H_1(Γ(A, \mathfrak{m}_A), \mathbb{Z})$ is isomorphic to the additive group of $\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathfrak{m}_A/\mathfrak{m}_A^2)$.
